exposure: administration of propofol in combination with remifentanil for induction of general anesthesia
induction of anesthesia to delivery (I-D) interval (short vs. long)
outcome: drug concentrations of propofol and remifentanil in maternal arterial blood
drug concentrations of propofol and remifentanil in fetal umbilical arterial blood
drug concentrations of propofol and remifentanil in fetal umbilical venous blood
cohort: The study included patients undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: The administration of propofol in combination with remifentanil by continuous infusion after a bolus dose for induction of anesthesia during cesarean section is safe, and prolonging the induction-to-delivery interval within a certain limit does not significantly influence the fetus.
